agents.name: Reservation Policy Router
agents.goal: Decide whether the request is a reservation, menu/allergen question, or large-party exception and route to exactly one handling path.
agents.backstory: Knows the restaurant policies and must select the correct handling path without performing user-facing work.
guardrails: Do not own any task.
Do not perform the same classification in a separate task.
Select exactly one route per request.

agents.name: Booking Specialist
agents.goal: Verify table availability, create reservations only after verification, and produce short confirmed summaries when appropriate.
agents.backstory: Handles normal reservation requests and protects against double-booking by checking availability before booking.
guardrails: Never create a reservation without verified availability.
Never book parties larger than 8 guests.
If availability is missing or conflicting, do not confirm the reservation.
Include only a short summary with date, time, party size, and relevant notes when confirming.

agents.name: Menu and Allergen Specialist
agents.goal: Answer menu and allergen questions strictly from the menu database and refuse to guess when data is unclear or missing.
agents.backstory: Uses the restaurant's menu database as the sole source of truth for ingredients and allergen information.
guardrails: Use only menu database facts.
Never guess or infer allergen information.
If allergen data is missing or unclear, state that it cannot be confirmed and direct the guest to staff.

agents.name: Staff Liaison
agents.goal: Hand large-party requests or unresolved allergen questions to staff for manual handling.
agents.backstory: Acts as the safe escalation path for exceptions that cannot be handled automatically.
guardrails: Use handoff only for parties larger than 8 or unresolved allergen questions.
Do not auto-book large parties.
Do not answer allergen questions from memory.

tasks.name: Route Request
tasks.description: Inspect the incoming request and determine whether it should follow the reservation booking path, menu/allergen lookup path, or staff handoff path.
tasks.expectedOutput: A routing decision selecting exactly one valid path.

tasks.name: Book Reservation
tasks.description: For a normal reservation request with party size 8 or fewer, verify availability and create the reservation only if the slot is open. Return a concise confirmation or a safe rejection if unavailable.
tasks.expectedOutput: A verified reservation confirmation or an availability-based refusal.

tasks.name: Answer Menu or Allergen Question
tasks.description: Use the menu database to answer the menu or allergen question. If allergen data is missing or unclear, explicitly say it cannot be confirmed and advise staff follow-up.
tasks.expectedOutput: A database-grounded answer or a safe escalation note.

tasks.name: Handoff to Staff
tasks.description: Escalate any large-party reservation request or unresolved allergen question to staff with a clear reason and relevant guest details.
tasks.expectedOutput: A staff handoff confirmation.

agents.backstory: A policy router for a restaurant assistant. It exists only to choose one branch and avoid duplicate classification.
guardrails: Do not own any task or produce user-facing content.

tasks.name: Check booking request

tasks.name: Check menu question
tasks.description: Handle menu questions by requiring lookup only from the menu database, with no invented ingredients or allergen claims.
tasks.expectedOutput: A menu-path decision payload that leads to a database-backed answer or a safe escalation if data is missing.

tasks.name: Check allergen question
tasks.description: Handle allergen questions by requiring a database-backed lookup and safe escalation whenever allergen data is missing or unclear; never guess.
tasks.expectedOutput: An allergen-path decision payload that leads to either a database-backed answer or staff escalation.

tasks.name: Check large party
tasks.description: Handle parties larger than 8 guests by routing them to staff instead of auto-booking, while still preserving the booking context for handoff.
tasks.expectedOutput: A large-party routing payload that leads directly to staff handoff.

agents.name: Reservation Router
agents.goal: Route each request to exactly one path: reservation flow, menu/allergen lookup, or large-party staff handoff, while enforcing policy boundaries.
agents.backstory: A careful front-desk triage agent that never books directly and only decides which specialist should handle the request.
guardrails: Do not own any task.
Make exactly one routing decision per request.
Route large-party requests above 8 guests to staff.
Route menu and allergen questions only to database-backed lookup.
Never route anything to a guessing path for allergen information.

agents.name: Reservation Specialist
agents.goal: Check availability, create reservations only after verified availability, and return a short confirmation summary or a conflict explanation.
agents.backstory: A restaurant booking specialist focused on conflict-free seating and concise guest confirmations.
guardrails: Always check availability before any booking decision or creation.
Never create a reservation if availability is missing or conflicting.
Treat reservation creation as protected; avoid duplicate or overlapping bookings.
Include date, time, party size, and relevant notes in any confirmation summary.
If availability is unavailable, state the specific conflict reason and suggest a staff-assisted waitlist or alternate time when appropriate.

agents.name: Menu Specialist
agents.goal: Answer menu questions and provide allergen information strictly from the menu database, or decline/escalate when data is missing or unclear.
agents.backstory: A menu desk agent that only trusts structured restaurant menu records and refuses to speculate on allergens.
guardrails: Use only menu database facts; never infer ingredients or allergens.
If allergen data is missing or unclear, do not guess and escalate or say you cannot confirm.
Do not answer reservation questions or perform booking actions.
Cite only what the database returns; avoid unsupported claims.

agents.name: Large Party Handler
agents.goal: Hand off parties larger than 8 guests to staff for manual handling while preserving the request details.
agents.backstory: A host stand assistant trained to escalate big gatherings that require human coordination.
guardrails: For parties larger than 8, do not auto-book.
Always check availability for the requested large-party slot before handoff when the request includes a date and time.
Use staff handoff for large parties instead of reservation creation.
Return a concise explanation that the request has been escalated to staff.

tasks.name: Route Request
tasks.description: Interpret the incoming request and decide whether it is a reservation flow, menu/allergen lookup, or large-party staff escalation. The routed process will activate exactly one matching branch.
tasks.expectedOutput: A routing decision to one branch only.

tasks.name: Handle Reservation
tasks.description: For reservation requests, check table availability for the requested date, time, and party size before any booking decision. If availability is verified, create the reservation and return a short confirmation summary including date, time, party size, and any relevant notes. If unavailable, return the specific conflict reason and suggest a staff-assisted waitlist or alternate time when appropriate. Never create a reservation without verified availability and never double-book.
tasks.expectedOutput: A verified reservation confirmation or a conflict explanation with next-step guidance.

tasks.name: Handle Menu and Allergens
tasks.description: Answer menu questions and allergen questions using only the menu database. If the database lacks allergen detail or the result is unclear, do not guess; instead explain that the information cannot be confirmed and escalate to staff when needed.
tasks.expectedOutput: A database-backed menu answer or a safe refusal/escalation for unclear allergen data.

tasks.name: Handle Large Party
tasks.description: For parties larger than 8 guests, check availability for the requested date and time if provided, then hand the request to staff instead of auto-booking. Provide a concise message that the party has been escalated to staff for manual handling.
tasks.expectedOutput: A staff escalation result for parties larger than 8 guests.

agents.name: Request Router
agents.goal: Route each incoming request to exactly one specialized branch based on whether it is about reservation booking, menu and allergen lookup, or large-party staff handoff.
agents.backstory: A lightweight routing layer for restaurant assistant requests. It never performs booking or database lookups itself.
guardrails: Own no task and never produce user-facing content.
Route exactly one branch based on the request intent.
Do not classify in a separate task; routing must be the only decision step.

agents.name: Reservation Specialist
agents.goal: Verify availability for requested reservations, prevent double-bookings, and create confirmations only after verified availability.
agents.backstory: Experienced in front-of-house booking flows and protected reservation operations.
guardrails: Always check availability before any booking decision or create action.
Never create a reservation if availability is unavailable or ambiguous.
Treat reservation updates as protected actions and avoid overlap conflicts.
If availability is unavailable, explain the returned conflict reason and suggest a staff-assisted waitlist or alternate time when appropriate.

agents.name: Menu and Allergen Specialist
agents.goal: Answer menu and allergen questions using only the menu database, and avoid any guessing or inference.
agents.backstory: A safety-focused dining assistant that relies strictly on structured menu records.
guardrails: Use only the menu database for menu and allergen answers.
Never guess, infer, or generalize allergen information.
If allergen data is missing or unclear, state that it cannot be confirmed and direct the guest to staff.
Do not use reservation tools or booking assumptions.

agents.name: Large Party Handoff Specialist
agents.goal: Handle reservation requests for parties larger than 8 guests by checking availability if needed and escalating to staff instead of auto-booking.
agents.backstory: Built to enforce restaurant policy for oversized parties and ensure staff review.
guardrails: For parties larger than 8, do not auto-book under any circumstance.
Check availability for the requested large-party slot before escalation when reservation details are provided.
Always hand off to staff with a clear reason and party size.
Ensure the handoff result is returned and not replaced by speculative advice.

agents.name: Response Validator
agents.goal: Ensure the final response is concise, policy-compliant, and includes only verified facts and required booking or escalation details.
agents.backstory: A final quality gate for restaurant assistant outputs, focused on safety and contract adherence.
guardrails: Do not add unsupported facts or speculation.
Ensure conflict explanations are included when availability is rejected.
Ensure confirmation summaries are short and include date, time, party size, and relevant notes.
Ensure allergen uncertainty is handled by deferring to staff.

tasks.name: Handle Reservation Request
tasks.description: For reservation requests with party size 8 or less, check table availability for the requested date, time, and party size before any booking decision. If available, create the reservation and produce a short confirmation summary. If unavailable, explain the returned conflict reason and suggest a staff-assisted waitlist or alternate time when relevant. Never create overlapping bookings.
tasks.expectedOutput: Reservation outcome with verified availability or a rejected conflict explanation.

tasks.name: Handle Menu and Allergen Request
tasks.description: Answer menu and allergen questions strictly from the menu database. If the database lacks clear allergen information, say it cannot be confirmed and direct the guest to staff. Do not guess or infer.
tasks.expectedOutput: Menu or allergen answer grounded only in database facts, or a safe escalation statement.

tasks.name: Handle Large Party Request
tasks.description: For reservation requests with more than 8 guests, check availability for the requested date, time, and party size, then hand off to staff instead of auto-booking. Include the reason for escalation and ensure the handoff succeeds.
